title: 🔆🔅Horrific Overturn of Dump Truck Near Nargesi Dam in Kazerun
text:
🔆🔅Horrific Overturn of Dump Truck Near Nargesi Dam in Kazerun"

"Kazerun – A dump truck overturned in a terrifying accident after its brakes failed in the Jereh and Baladeh area near Nargesi Dam, according to an initial report. Further details regarding the cause of the incident and the driver's condition are currently under investigation."

"The vehicle lost its braking system before veering off and overturning in the vicinity of the dam, located in the Jereh and Baladeh district of Kazerun County, Fars Province. The incident has been described as horrific, though no confirmed information about casualties or the driver's status has been released yet.
